summary.headline: $500M worker retraining push lifts Egalitarian Utopia
summary.body: A modestly brighter day. RAISE US, a nonprofit led by Gina Raimondo and Eric Holcomb, launched with more than $500 million from Amazon, Anthropic, Microsoft and the OpenAI Foundation to retrain workers, aiming for $1 billion. Spreading AI's benefits raises Shared Prosperity, the main ingredient of Egalitarian Utopia, a world where AI wealth is shared by everyone. In Washington, the House Science Committee advanced 10 bipartisan AI bills on research compute, security, flaw reporting, provenance, workforce and data-center energy, a small plus for Global Coordination that nudges Gatekeeper up and Self-Destruction down. Horizon Balance rose to +0.89.
summary.movers_note: Egalitarian Utopia +0.4, Self-Destruction -0.1 and Gatekeeper +0.1. RAISE US drove Egalitarian Utopia (+0.42 from that event); the House bills did the rest.

events.title: House Science Committee advances 10 bipartisan AI bills
events.summary: The committee reported bills on research compute access (CREATE AI Act), AI security, flaw reporting, provenance, workforce and data-center energy measurement; Senators also introduced the AI Labeling Act.
events.reason: Non-prescriptive bills advancing; words more than action.
